@clerk/shared: postinstall prints Clerk's development-instance telemetry notice once and writes a marker under the user's config directory; nothing is downloaded. Reached through @clerk/themes.
@prisma/engines: postinstall downloads the Prisma query and schema engines for the current platform. Required: prisma generate and every database call use them.
core-js: postinstall prints a funding banner and swallows every error. Reached through jspdf and canvg; optional.
esbuild: postinstall verifies or installs the platform-specific esbuild binary. Used by tsx and Vite.
fsevents: Builds the macOS file-watching native module. Optional and skipped on Linux, including Vercel and CI.
libxmljs2: postinstall attempts to select or compile native libxml bindings. Optional dependency of @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm for XML validation.
prisma: preinstall runs Prisma's version check, which warns about incompatible global installs; nothing is downloaded.
unrs-resolver: postinstall (napi-postinstall) selects the prebuilt native binary for this platform. Used by the ESLint import resolver.
